content: Isaac-gwalulesad
Bab-Jehová e-sogsadba Saraʼgi ise-nued binsasad. Saraʼga ise-sogar-imaksadba ega ibmar imaknonikid.
Degisoggu, Sara bonigwar gunonikid. Deunni, Abraham bato nue seredgusad. Bab-Dummad Abrahamʼga-sogsadyobi, a-ibagangi Sara susugwa baknonikid.
Abraham, Sara-ega-susugwa-baksadi Isaacʼye onugsasad.
Isaac ibabaabakgus-gwalulesadgi (8), Abraham Bab-Dummad-ega-sogsadba, Isaacʼga abgan-uka-duku siksad.
Abraham birga-dulatar (100) nikadgi, Isaac gwalulenonikid.
Geb degine, Sara sogded: “Bab-Dummad an-oallisad, bela dulemar susugwa-nikusye an-wisguarmalale, anba weligwaledba allemarmogoed.”
Sara sogdebalid: “¿Ar wede doa Abrahamʼga sogoen be insae, ani, Sara, ega mimmi bakoye? Dule sogosulina. Ar emigindi, be dakena, ar Abraham bato seredgus-inigwele, degite, anga machigwa baksad.”
Agar, e-machi-Ismaelʼbo onolesad
Machigwa-Isaac dunguded, degine, mam-iargunonikid. Mam-iargusad-ibagi, Abraham iba-dummad onosad.
A-iba-ononaidgi Sara dakded, Agar-e-machi-Ismael Isaacʼgi dodonai. We-machide Agar Abraham-ebo baksadid. Agarʼde Egipto-duled.
A-ular, Sara Abrahamʼga sogded: —¡We-mai, degine, e-machi we-neggi be onoge! We-mai-e-machi an-machi-sunnagwadyob geg an-machi-Isaacʼba, be-ibmar-beoedi abingamogad.
Ar Ismael Abraham-machi-sunnad gusoggu, Sara weyob Abrahamʼga ibmar-sogsadi, Abraham nue-nunmak itosad.
Ar Bab-Dummaddi Abrahamʼga sogded: “Melle be-machigi, degine, be-maigi nunmak be itoge. Ar ibi Sara bese egichialile, aba be ibmar sae. Ar ade, Isaac-waganbi be-wagan-sunnadga gumaloed.
Ar be-mai-machidi be-machibarsoggu, amba deyob an imakbaloed, dule-bukidar-guega an imakmogoed.”

Neg-oibosadgi, wakudaryalaba, Abraham Agarʼga madu, degi, buglugi dii ega uksad. Abraham Agar-gukingi bela ega ibmar nasiksad. Geb degi, Agarʼga e-machi-Ismael-uksagu, barmisad. Agar nadegusad, Beersebaʼsik nega-dulesulidganba bipirmakdii gusad.
Buglugi dii-siid bergusgu, Agar sapi-urba e-machi sisad.
Agarʼdi bannabasaar wilubba-banguedgi signaded. Ar ade, binsasad: “Machi burgwialir, an dakbisulid.” Agar sigidapgu, machi boalid.
Bab-Dummad, machigwa bosiid itosad. Bab-Dummad-e-baliwitur nibneg-akar Agarʼse gornonikid, ega sogded: “¿Agar, igi be itoge? Mer be bukib itoge, ar Bab-Dummad be-machi-bosiid itosad.
Be nae, be-machi be suna. Nue be-argangi be gao, mer indako. Ar ade, an we-machigwagi dule-bukidar-gued an imakoed.”
Geb degine, Bab-Dummad Agar dia-siid-dakega imaksad. Agar diase nade gusad. Geb buglugi dii enosad. Geb degine, diigi Ismael-ogobsad.
Ismael-dungumaidba Bab-Dummad Ismael-bendaksad. A-machigwade nega-dulesulidgi maigusad. Agi, yeer sigu-mie gunonikid.
Sapingwagusgu, Parán-nega-dulesulidgangi-maidgi, e-nan ega ome-Egiptoʼgined uksad.
Abraham Abimelec-ebo igar-mesisad

A-ibagangine, deunni, Abimelec Abrahamʼga sunmaknade gusad. Ficol eba nade gusmogad. Ficolʼde Abimelec-e-sordamar-e-dummadga gudiid. Abimelec, Abrahamʼga sogdapid: —Bela be ibmar-imakdele, Bab-Dummad nue-be-bendake anmar daked.

Degisoggu, weyob, Bab-Dummad-nuggi ise-sogar be anga soge, akar be an-imakosurye, degine, an-mimmigan, degi, an-wagan akar be imakosurbarye. Igi-nued an be-imaksamoga, deyob be an-imakmogoed, degine, emi we-yargi-be-gudiid-e-dulemar deyob be imakbaloed.
Abraham, Abimelec-abin sogded: —Napira-Bab-Dummad-nuggi ise-sogar an bega soged: ‘Eye, an imakosuli.’
Geb degine, Abraham, Abimelecʼga sogded, igi Abimelec-e-maimala e-ibe dia susmala.
Abimelec Abraham-abin sogded: —An wissulid wede doa deyob imaksa. Ar bede anga sogsasulid. Ar emi geb an itogwichid.
Geb degine, Abraham sibad-wawaadmar, moli-bebe-nikamalad susad, geb degine, Abimelecʼga uksad. A-ibagine, Abimelec Abraham-ebo igar mesismalad.
Ar Abrahamʼdi e-sibad-wawaad-bukwadgi sibad-wawaad-ome-senigana walagugle (7) susad. Geb degine, amar bachikii urbisad.
A-ulale, Abimelec Abrahamʼse egichialid: —¿Ar ibiga-wede be sibad-wawaad-ome-senigana walagugle (7) be bachikii urbisa?
Abraham abin-imakded: —Ar we-sibad-wawaad-ome-senigana walagugle (7) an bega uked, adi, soglegegalad, we-dia, ani an akwisye.
A-ulale, emar-gunanaidgi Beersebaʼye onugsasmalad. Ar ade, na ebogwa sogsamalad, anmar ibmar-sogsamaladi imakedseye, geg anmar imaksuli guye.
Beersebaʼgi na igar-nabosmargu, Abimelec, degine, e-sordamar-idued-Ficolʼmala gannar Filistea-neggweburmarse nadmalad.
Abrahamʼdi Beersebaʼgi ingwa-soled-sapi digsad. Agine, Bab-Dummad-Jehová-Degisadeguadse gochad.
Abraham birga-suitii Filistea-dulemar-yargi maigusad.
